_captured: 2026-08-01, real @playwright/cli 0.1.17. Two real error responses captured against the live browser: an eval syntax error and a tab-select on a non-existent tab index.
_finding: Both exit with process exit code 0 (execFile does NOT reject) and report the error via `{"isError": true, "error": "..."}` on stdout instead. gpt_send.mjs/gpt_watch.mjs previously only treated a non-zero exit / exec throw as CLI_EXEC_FAILED and never inspected `isError`, so a real CLI error would have parsed as valid JSON with no `result`/`url`/array shape - happening to still fail closed downstream (TAB_NOT_FOUND / VERIFY_URL_MISMATCH) but mislabeled and by accident, not by design. Fixed: runCliCommand() now explicitly checks `parsed.isError === true` and throws CLI_ERROR_RESPONSE.
